name: Somchai Wisutrattanakul
bio:
Somchai's journey in motorsport began unconventionally, not with a passion for racing itself, but with an innate talent for organization and problem-solving. After years in the Thai import-export business, a chance encounter with a struggling local racing team ignited a new career path. He quickly proved invaluable, untangling logistical nightmares and ensuring equipment arrived on time and in perfect condition. His reputation for meticulous planning and resourcefulness spread, eventually attracting the attention of Arrow McLaren.

His approach to logistics is simple: anticipate every possible problem and have a solution ready. Somchai believes that a smooth-running logistics operation is the unsung hero of any successful racing team, allowing the engineers and drivers to focus solely on performance. He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to find creative solutions to even the most challenging logistical hurdles. What sets Somchai apart is his deep understanding of international shipping regulations and his extensive network of contacts throughout Southeast Asia, making him an indispensable asset to the team.

physical.description: A wiry man of average height, Somchai always carries himself with a quiet confidence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with meticulously detailed schedules.
Refuses to fly without his lucky Buddha amulet.
Starts every day with a strong cup of Thai iced coffee, regardless of the weather.
